blind.description: A stylized low-poly wooden crate or bin with four sturdy orange-brown corner posts and horizontal mossy-green painted side planks. It is filled to the brim with dark charcoal-grey coal chunks. Sticking out of the coal is a small wooden hand shovel or scoop. At the front-left corner outside the box, several loose chunks of coal are spilled on the ground. Hand-painted stylized texture work throughout.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden frame with four square corner post tops enclosing a pile of black coal chunks, with a wooden scoop resting in the upper-right area and a few spilled coal lumps on the ground outside the bottom rim.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2 feet tall to the bin rim (around 2.5 feet to the top of the scoop handle), roughly 35-40% of the figure's height; width is about 3 feet across.
